conditioning_rule.definition: c is fixed before candidate measurements and may denote one semantic stratum or an ordered repair-driven training trajectory
forbidden: requiring unrelated states to share an absolute parameter direction
choosing c from the observed candidate drift
using T4 or SEUP verdicts as formation labels

exact_object.local_residual: epsilon = z_candidate - z_repair at one closed F+B semantic boundary
exact_object.effective_influence: A_bar = integral_0^1 D U_s(z_repair+t epsilon) dt

exact_parity_budget.formation: E[F(epsilon)|c] = integral p_s F_e + integral p_a F_o

basis_free_metrics.pairing_excess: effective resultant under real pairing minus its preregistered pairing-permutation control
basis_free_metrics.orbit_defect: effective resultant ratio across mathematically equivalent implementation schedules
basis_free_metrics.even_energy_on_sign_crossings: fraction of response-even energy carried by those coordinates

interpretation.source_asymmetry: source resultant is nonzero and mean-removal or precision/schedule repair suppresses effective work
interpretation.error_influence_coupling: source marginal is preserved but pairing disruption suppresses effective work
interpretation.nonodd_response: a norm/support-matched plus/minus residual has nonzero oddness defect
interpretation.variance_only: effective contributions remain antithetically centered under the declared condition

required_causal_controls: same pre-step weights and optimizer state
residual marginal preservation for a coupling intervention
continuous effect sizes instead of a post-hoc universal threshold
relationship_to_persistence: SEUP and feedback are evaluated only after bias formation; they are not part of this marker.
